title: There are matroid toric ideals without quadratic Gröbner bases
summary: Our paper shows that if a matroid contains the Fano plane or its dual as a minor, then its toric ideal does not have any quadratic Gröbner basis. More than 25 years ago, Hibi, Herzog, and Sturmfels established a direct connection between the existence of quadratic Gröbner bases and regular unimodular flag triangulations.
